title: 1. Re-nominate R-076: reshape the stroke within each roll cycle
hypothesis: Redistributing stroke motion within each roll cycle reduces return-stroke opposition and raises sustained spin without increasing grasp compression.

prediction.rationale: A ten-point sustained-success gain would justify waveform repair; this directly tests stroke efficiency rather than another feedback signal. R-076's operating-point prerequisite is now resolved: D-059 adopted the fixed-amplitude parent. D-058 changed amplitude and D-061 changed global phase lead; neither tested within-cycle waveform shape.

protocol.command: gpu run 'bash -lc "source ~/IsaacLab/source_env.sh && python scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py --config config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml --study r086_phase_warp --log-dir logs/pen_spin/r086_phase_warp"'
code_changes: New study module lares/envs/isaac_pen_spin/phase_warp.py registered as --study r086_phase_warp in scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py; settings in the research_protocols block of config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml. Parent: the D-058 incumbent (config/pen_spin/d058_fixed_stroke_incumbent, hashes checked); amplitude, phase lead, zero compression, stroke gain, centring and grasp unchanged; no LLM.

Mechanism: the stroke phase is the pen's roll angle phi = atan2(sin_roll, cos_roll) from the quaternion twist. One audited substitution at the roll stage applies h(phi) = phi + epsilon sin(phi) (epsilon -0.35 or +0.35) and, per finger, re-centres and rescales the warped sin_phase and cos_phase channels to the unwarped channel's cycle mean and RMS, using constants computed offline on a 3600-point phase grid at the frozen phase_lead and finger offsets, written to disk with their hash before any episode. At epsilon = 0 the substitution returns the original tensors untouched; gated bit for bit offline on D-050's archived observations.

One frozen 160-case Stage-3 manifest (seed 4690) at config/manifests/pen_spin_stage3_r086_block_s4690.yaml: cases 0-9 unused, promotion 10-39, screen 40-79, fresh 80-159; placement-disjoint from every committed pen-spin manifest. Both warps and the parent on the 40 screen cases, each in its own process; the winner (sustained successes, then fewer drops, then candidate order) frozen before any confirmation episode; winner and parent on promotion and fresh, each in its own process. 3 x 40 + 2 x 110 = 340 episodes, zero LLM calls.

Primary: winner minus parent fresh sustained success (80 pairs), 95% t interval; at least +0.10; supported if the mean is at least +0.10 with the lower bound above zero; refuted if the upper bound is below +0.10; otherwise inconclusive. Adoption: the standing strict rule on cases 10-39 (positive difference, lower bound above zero), fresh lower bound above zero, no more observed drops on either panel. Reported: sustained success, drops, failure split, in-play mean |spin|, drive and per-axis action saturation, the warp's realised per-finger channel mean and RMS on recorded observations, both candidates' screen scores. Final test untouched.

falsified_by: The fresh paired interval's upper bound is below +0.10. An interval spanning the threshold is inconclusive. A success gain accompanied by more drops is not an adoptable repair.

notes: Primary, predeclared (80 fresh pairs): winner (epsilon -0.35) minus parent +0.0875 [+0.015, +0.160] (32/80 vs 25/80; 8 wins, 1 loss, 71 ties). The lower bound is above zero but the mean is below +0.10 and the upper bound above it: inconclusive for the predicted magnitude; an improvement of some size is established on this panel. Drops 3 vs 3.

Promotion (30 pairs): +0.1000 [-0.014, +0.214] (10 vs 7; 3 wins, 0 losses, 27 ties), drops 4 vs 4. The strict rule's lower bound is -0.014, so the warp is NOT adopted on this run by the predeclared rule, although it meets the fresh condition and the drop condition. Screens: warp -0.35 17/40, parent 16/40, warp +0.35 13/40 (drops 3 each).

Mechanism: the negative warp slows the stroke's phase around the roll angle's zero and speeds it around +-pi (h(phi) = phi - 0.35 sin phi), so the loaded stroke dwells where sin(phi) is small; the positive warp did the opposite and screened worse than the parent. Realised per-finger sin-channel RMS on recorded steps is 0.74 / 0.59 for the warp against 0.79 / 0.61 for the parent (the pen's roll angle is not uniform in time, so the grid normalisation does not land exactly on the realised cycle). In-play |spin| 4.38 vs 4.04 fresh; slow-spin tail failures 39 vs 47; off-centre 6 vs 5.

Pattern: as with the zero-curl clamp (D-052, D-054, D-055, D-056), a fresh panel favours the candidate while the 30-pair promotion panel lands just short of the strict lower bound (-0.014); the fresh lower bound (+0.015) is what a larger instrument would resolve.
Saturation: drive above 0.99 on 95-99% of recorded in-play steps in both arms; executed-action saturation 8-9% of components. Recorded in-play steps only.
Accounting: 340 Isaac episodes in seven fresh processes, 0 LLM calls, about 7 min wall time. No deviation from the approved protocol. Final-test split untouched.

verdicts.reasoning: Predicted at least +0.10 fresh success for the selected warp over the D-058 incumbent; observed +0.0875 [+0.015, +0.160] on 80 pairs (32 vs 25; 8 wins, 1 loss, 71 ties) for epsilon -0.35: the lower bound is above zero but the mean is below +0.10 and the upper bound above it, so the predicted magnitude is neither established nor refuted; an improvement of some size is established on this panel, with equal drops. Promotion +0.100 [-0.014, +0.214] (10 vs 7; 3 wins, 0 losses) misses the strict lower bound by 0.014, so by the predeclared rule the warp is not adopted. This is the fourth time a candidate on this learner has shown a positive fresh panel while a 30-pair promotion panel landed just short; for the clamp the 90-pair instrument (D-057) settled it. Confidence 0.8: identity gate exact, prospective screen and confirmation, but one block and a magnitude near the threshold.
verdicts.next_experiment: The negative warp is the first stroke-shape change with an established fresh gain on the adopted incumbent (and the only candidate besides the fixed gain to win against it). Qualify it the way the clamp was qualified: one predeclared 90-pair instrument (three cases-10-39 panels) under the standing rule, 180 episodes, then adopt or not. If it qualifies, it becomes the incumbent and the warp magnitude could be swept open-loop (one more screen) before any further mechanism work; if not, the incumbent stands and the sequence is complete.

(1) Partition on one frozen 160-case Stage-3 manifest (seed 4690): cases 0-9 unused, promotion 10-39, screen 40-79, fresh 80-159; both warps and the parent screened on the 40 screen cases in their own processes; the winner (successes, fewer drops, candidate order) frozen before confirmation; winner and parent on promotion and fresh; 3 x 40 + 2 x 110 = 340 episodes, zero LLM calls. (3) Identity: at epsilon = 0 the substitution returns the original tensors untouched (atan2 followed by sin is not bit-exact), gated bit for bit offline on D-050's archived observations. (4) Interface: --study r086_phase_warp with --log-dir and a config block in config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml; manifest config/manifests/pen_spin_stage3_r086_block_s4690.yaml. (5) Prediction retained (winner minus parent fresh at least +0.10; supported if the mean is at least +0.10 with the lower bound above zero; refuted if the upper bound is below +0.10); adoption needs the standing strict rule on cases 10-39, fresh lower bound above zero and no more observed drops; reported: sustained success, drops, failure split, spin, drive and per-axis action saturation, the warp's realised per-finger mean and RMS from recorded observations.
